observation.visible_scene: A close-up of a white rug laid flat and covered with a wet, soapy foam layer. A stainless-steel cleaning head mounted on a long angled pole/handle rests on the rug surface; a mass of white foam/bristles is attached to the head's leading (right) edge, and a blue label is visible on the head's left side. A 'MOUNTAIN RUG CLEANING' logo sits in the upper-right corner. A horizontal ridge of foam runs across the rug behind the head.
visible_changes: The metal head moves from a center-right position toward the left edge of the frame over the segment, then shifts slightly back toward the center in the final frames (a sweeping, side-to-side pass rather than a single start-to-stop motion).
The pole/handle angle and the head's orientation change as it travels, altering which faces (blue label vs. side plate) are visible.
The white foam/bristle mass on the head's front edge changes shape and position relative to the head as it drags across the surface.
The horizontal foam ridge on the rug is visibly displaced/reshaped in the area the head passes over.
outside_clip_unknowns: No operator or hand is visible; the cause of the head's movement is not shown.
Whether this is scrubbing, rinsing, or foam application, and the outcome after the clip, is not determinable.
The motion is already ongoing at the first frame and continues past the last; no start or completion is captured.
uncertain_details: The apparent leftward-then-slight-rightward path could partly reflect camera angle/perspective change rather than pure object translation; background rug edges give limited evidence.
The blue label's disappearance from view is due to the head rotating/occlusion, not the label detaching.
